units: mm (owner-confirmed 1 OBJ unit = 1 mm; no physical calibration)

tool.noise_source: RMS of the deck plane fit in params/frame.json

split: each window's vertices are split in two by a hash of the vertex index; one half is fitted, the other is measured by check_features.py
claims: fitted numbers on acquired scan vertices in the twin frame; the standard deviations assume independent noise and are a lower bound; no dimension of the specimen is established
datum_rule: The datum axis of a valve is the axis of its guide bore when the bore is acquired at both ends. Otherwise it is the line through two fitted centres far apart, the throat and the guide outside diameter at the cam end, because a feature a few millimetres long fixes where its axis is, not where it points. The datum of a plug is its thread bore, of a stud its passage, when the fit is determined. The register recess is a ring 5.5 mm long and is given no datum axis.

datum_checks.purpose: the two-centre construction used for valve_y_plus, tried on the valve whose guide bore axis is measured
